rules.candidate: a '='/'equals' anchor whose lhs window (90 chars) shows NUM-op-NUM (the in-line detector's trigger gate), plus every '<<expr=result>>' scratchpad annotation
rules.wellformed: lhs parses as 2+ numbers joined by arithmetic ops ('x' and 'N% of M' included; % operands valued at n/100); result token parses; comma/decimal grouping valid
rules.slip: stated result differs from the exact recomputation (Fraction arithmetic) by more than half a display unit at the stated precision, under EITHER standard precedence or left-to-right evaluation
rules.provenance: final answer must equal a verified chain value (stated results of passing statements or their exact recomputed values); '####' first, then 'answer is', then last number
rules.known_limitations_censused_not_hidden: dimensional forms ('12 miles / 12 hours'), fraction operands ('20/3'), parenthesized rhs — counted as false parses; they are missed-statement classes, never false fires
